description: Solid Waste Management Services - Transfer Station Locations is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. FID - system field, record identifier SHAPE - system field, file type indentifier ADDRESS - street address of transfer station NAME - name of transfer station The data was geocoded based on the address of each Transfer station and the data is limited to the City of Toronto Boundaries. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are garbage depot, transfer station, waste depot. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, XLS. The portal shows 2025-07-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
